about.title: About REGA
about.intro: REGA (ڕێگا) is a modern, trusted digital platform, founded as a multilingual guide for the Kurdish diaspora in Germany and Europe.
about.goal: Our aim is to bring all the main everyday needs and searches together in one place, so you can easily reach services that suit you culturally and linguistically, while giving business owners and professionals an official, trusted way to present their work and skills.

offer.label: Service guide
offer.text: Easily find services and professionals near where you live, on a map.

offer.label: Trust and assurance
offer.text: Verified information (Rega Verified) and a transparent rating system.

offer.label: Smart support
offer.text: Artificial intelligence (REGA AI) to make searching easier and answer your needs.

about.quote: REGA is the bridge between you and the trusted services around you.

forBusiness.title: For businesses
forBusiness.lead: Introduce your business to Kurds in Germany and Europe, in their language and near them.
forBusiness.freeBody: Listing on REGA is completely free. There are no fees, subscriptions, paid placements or payments, and there won't be.
forBusiness.b1Text: Your description is shown in seven languages, including Sorani and Kurmanji.
forBusiness.b2Text: You appear on the map and in the “Nearby” search.
forBusiness.b3Text: The REGA Assistant suggests your listing when someone asks for something that fits.
forBusiness.b4Text: Every listing is reviewed, and you can earn the Rega Verified badge.
forBusiness.s1: Create an account and confirm your email.
forBusiness.s2: Fill in your details: category, city, address, map pin, opening hours and photos.
forBusiness.s3: Submit it for review. Our team checks your listing.
forBusiness.s4: After approval it goes live and people can find you.
forBusiness.verifiedBody: When our team has checked certain details of your listing, you receive the Rega Verified badge. It is not an endorsement or a quality guarantee; it shows that details were checked.
forBusiness.ctaLogin: Already have an account? Sign in

geo.title: Countries, regions and cities
geo.intro: Country ← region ← city. Add new countries or cities here, no code needed. Deactivated entries do not appear in lists.

cms.title: Pages (CMS)
cms.intro: Write static pages in every language (e.g. the founding story). Published pages appear at /p/slug and in the sitemap.
cms.bodyHint: Blank line = new paragraph; “## ” = heading; “- ” = list item. Only languages with a title and content are published.
cms.errorInvalid: Invalid input (slug: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only).
